chunks: From him, from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from Ibn Sinan, from Mansur al-Siqlabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
It is permissible for a man to enjoy (marry) a Magus woman.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a Muslim man to marry a Zoroastrian woman in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling to clarify that Zoroastrians (Magus) are considered *Ahl al-Kitab* for the purpose of temporary marriage (*Mut'ah*), a view supported by many Shia jurists who extend the permissibility beyond Jews and Christians. This hadith specifically addresses the permissibility for a man, distinguishing it from the broader chapter context which emphasizes the moral qualification of the woman being 'chaste' and 'knowing' (*al-'arifah al-'afifa*).
